rootCause: In-game MessageManager uses the native canvas text path, bypassing EmojiAwareText; the MSDF atlas has no emoji glyphs.
additionalDefect: BMP emoji bases such as U+203C, U+2194 and U+24C2 were missing from cluster detection; VS16 was incorrectly accepted as a separate base.
fixes: Native canvas records platform RGBA emoji clusters and measures mixed text consistently
BMP emoji base coverage restored; standalone variation selectors remain ordinary text
Actual MessageManager author/body/multiline route covered by regression
previewScope: CPU composition from recorded canvas commands with real desktop glyph pixels; not a native GPU screenshot of chat input.
nativeRenderingScope: Separate new-protocol stock-sprite and own-view replay GUI checks on an inactive virtual display; does not prove native in-game chat glyph display.
